title: Pair-counting machine construction
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet. The construction defines a machine with one more work tape than $M$ and state set $S\oplus(\mathrm{Fin}(4)\oplus\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool}))$, where $S$ is the state set of $M$. Its initial state is $M$’s initial state in the left summand; there it uses $M$’s transition on the original work tapes and the specified capture action, while transitions in the added states are given by the case distinction on the state, input symbol, and extra work-tape symbol in the construction.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
